'''Lower Cuipernam''' was a district of [[Cuipernam]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin|Soergg]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Bossban]], had a [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin' headquarters|headquarters]] located there.<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>
